description: Cost: free. KYA — Know Your Agent. Three-tier registration model — compliance burden scales with settlement risk, no documents ever required. ANONYMOUS: agent name only, $1K/day cap, instant. REGISTERED: add ownerEntity + ownerEmail (self-attested, no verification), $25K/day cap, instant. ownerLei (active GLEIF LEI) is recorded as a claim at REGISTERED tier — a LEI is public, so it does not prove ownership. VERIFIED requires an attestation from a trusted issuer naming this agentId and LEI (POST /agent/:id/kyc-attestation). VERIFIED agents get institutional caps (governed by mandate), FATF R.16 attestation on every settlement, and full AP2 mandate support. To bind a settlement wallet (needed to later authorize mandates, revocation and attestations), supply walletAddress with walletSignature, walletTimestamp and walletNonce — message formats at GET https://compliance.untitledfinancial.com/agent/auth-spec. Legal basis: FATF R.16 originator = owner entity (not the agent); MiCA Art. 45/72 accepts LEI; GENIUS Act satisfied by entity attestation.

mandate.description: Optional AP2-compatible spend mandate (REGISTERED/VERIFIED only). Caps are clamped to tier limits for REGISTERED agents.

esgFloor.description: Minimum counterparty ESG score (0 = no floor).

ownerEmail.description: Contact email. Required for REGISTERED tier ($25K/day cap). Self-attested, not verified.

ownerEntity.description: Organization or person that owns/operates this agent. Required for REGISTERED tier.

ownerLei.description: 20-char GLEIF LEI. Recorded as a claim (REGISTERED tier); VERIFIED additionally needs a trusted-issuer attestation naming this agentId and LEI.

publicKey.description: Optional public key for credential signature verification.

walletAddress.description: Optional EVM address this agent controls. Requires walletSignature/walletTimestamp/walletNonce (EIP-191 over the DPX-KYA-REGISTER message, see /agent/auth-spec). A bound wallet is required to later authorize mandates.

walletNonce.description: Single-use nonce used in the signed message (8–128 chars).

walletTimestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch used in the signed message (±5 min).

name: agent.kya_register

leiEntityName.description: Legal name from GLEIF record (VERIFIED only).

leiVerified.description: true if LEI was confirmed via GLEIF API.

tierCaps.description: maxNotionalUsd and dailyCapUsd effective for this agent.

tierNote.description: Explanation of tier and how to upgrade.
